editorNotes: This seed follows current MP-001 rules: both starting XIs, exactly 22 hidden starters, one global input, no playable substitutes, and display-only positions.
The file is draft rather than published until a future validator confirms all cross-reference and duplicate-alias checks automatically.
Accent-bearing aliases are included where useful, but display names use unaccented ASCII for implementation simplicity.
FootballSquads abbreviates some club names; hint text expands obvious abbreviations such as Manchester C to Manchester City and Tottenham H to Tottenham Hotspur.

Hint policy migrated on 2026-05-08: hint 1 is also-played-for, hint 2 is club at match time for this international match, and hint 3 is first name. Also-played-for clues now have direct WorldFootball.net profile source refs, but remain medium confidence until cross-checked.
